name: r80_sm_currentonly_shadow_v008
purpose: Background revalidation of the unchanged current-only CurveMLP protocol on the completed frozen v008 dataset. The prior v006 first32 LCB ranking was better than live on one cohort only; this does not authorize deployment, and CNN/weighted-loss branches are not continued.

live_model_physical_audit.verified_facts: All three bound v008 checkpoints have 3900 optimizer steps and norms exactly matching the 1855 effective profile_train rows. The audit also replays the 48 saved live predictions without reading HFSS truth.
live_model_physical_audit.limit: This tracked audit is provenance for the existing live scorer. The future shadow comparison still performs its own checkpoint/state/norm gates before prediction.

shadow_protocol.derivation: Take the exact frozen source protocol and change only model.legacy_epochs from 30 to 0 before recomputing protocol_id.
shadow_protocol.normalization: Fit input and all 216 target coordinates on exactly the 1855 frozen profile_train rows only, using script.symmetry_training._fit_norm.
shadow_protocol.group_weights: Use existing inverse canonical-group frequency weights from script.symmetry_training._weights.
shadow_protocol.comparison_to_v006: Same current-only protocol, architecture, seeds, Adam settings, 100 current epochs, phase index 0, group weighting, and train-only normalization rule; the frozen dataset version is the only intended recipe input change.

frozen_data.copy_policy: Copy only manifest-referenced local files into the isolated shadow root and verify every source and destination SHA256 against the frozen manifest. Preserve v008 manifest/receipt bytes; no NAS discovery.

selected48_background_comparison.required_training_exclusion: All 48 selected pattern hashes must be absent from the 2739-row frozen training manifest.
selected48_background_comparison.future_shadow_prediction_timing: Save all 48 current-only shadow curves and existing-scorer outputs before this shadow evaluator reads selected48 truth. Do not claim fully prospective timing: root had already read aggregate data and some v008 HFSS had run.
selected48_background_comparison.truth_policy: Preparation and the future train/predict helper must not open selected48 HFSS result stores, reports, rows, failures, or frozen truth.

same_884_profile_holdout.selection_policy: Descriptive frozen development holdout only; no tuning, early stopping, or automatic adoption.

same_selected48.pre_truth_output: Save 48 predictions in exact frozen guided-manifest order with predicted_before_hfss=false and selected48_truth_read=false.

predeclared_evaluation.claim_limit: A newer-data background revalidation is not an independent generalization result, a one-factor causal efficacy estimate, or authority to deploy. CNN and weighted-loss branches are not retuned.

execution_policy.implementation: Reuse script.symmetry_training.train_version and load_current_predictor without source edits.

historical_context.interpretation: One completed cohort favored current-only ranking, while CNN and weighted-loss did not improve ranking. Keep live unchanged and revalidate only current-only on frozen v008.
